data.text: [00:04]Well, what do you think? We’re going in March, so we need to get the tickets soon. Where would you like to go?
[00:12]Umm … I think Barcelona sounds really good, or maybe Edinburgh … I’m not sure. `[00:19]There are lots of great things to see and do in both places. What do you think?

[00:25]Umm … I think Edinburgh is too cold for me … I mean, cold weather isn’t my idea of fun! `[00:32.3]I like warmer weather … four degrees is too cold! `[00:36]Barcelona is a bit warmer. Is it warm enough?
[00:40.5]Yes, I think so … it’s warm enough for me. I don’t like it too hot.
[00:45.5]Oh really? I’d prefer somewhere very warm … like Rio. `[00:50]I like the idea of going to the beach.
[00:52.4]Yes, but Rio is too far away. `[00:54.9]I’m not keen on sitting on a plane for twelve hours or something … and it’s too expensive to get there …
[01:01]I suppose you’re right … . But, look … Edinburgh is expensive, too… the accommodation, I mean.
[01:07.9]Well, what about Barcelona? I’d like to go somewhere on the coast.
[01:12.7]OK … it sounds really fun there. And it isn’t too far away, is it?
[01:17.7]OK then … . Shall I book the tickets this afternoon?
